continuity: Jin’s heart-meridian injury is healed, and his other listed injuries and status effects are removed; the fight with the Grand Mage continues.
The Grand Mage says she lacks authority to kill Jin and acts to save him because her master has waited a long time for him.
plot: The Grand Mage realizes Jin Taekyung’s resolve and the limits of her authority, but he severs his own heart meridians rather than submit. Desperate to save him, she unleashes healing power that engulfs the hill.

Jin survives as the System removes his injuries and grants him the “Go Ahead, Gut Me!” achievement. He recalls the White Flame spear, breaks free of the vines, and attacks the Grand Mage. She evades with Blink, but Jin anticipates her movement and closes in.
translation_decisions: Render the achievement 배 째 as “Go Ahead, Gut Me!”
Render 필활 as “will to save” in contrast with 필살, “will to kill.”

active_continuity: The Grand Mage says the Lord of Heaven ordered her faction to watch Jin Taekyung and wants him to survive and grow stronger; the reason is unknown.
The Grand Mage identifies Jin as the Chosen One, matching the title the Bow Saint used based on the Martial God’s letter.
The Grand Mage says she lacks authority to kill Jin and acts to save him because her master has waited a long time for him.
Jin severed his heart meridians while bound by the Grand Mage’s plant magic, then survived after her healing power took effect; his injuries and listed status effects were removed.
Jin broke free of the vines and attacked the Grand Mage; she evaded with Blink, and Jin closed in on her. The fight continues.
